files.note: High oblique drone aerial from the southeast corner looking across the bowl to the west end and campus; field left of center, roughly rows 620-1150. Early March: a little snow on the concourse and track at lower right.

closest_misses.why: 2012 elevated empty panorama at 7170x3000; pre-dates the 2014 west end (Cougar Football Complex) and the field is a thin strip.
